title: SCORE LABEL CLEAR OF THE TOP EDGE
why: The critic on the raid screen (10-19): the SCORE label is clipped at y=0. The block rides 10 to 14 pixels lower and the label is quiet grey.
now: The score label at the top centre is no longer cut off by the top edge.

edits.anchor: var fb=FSz(TYPE.title,z), fs=FSz(TYPE.micro,z), mh=/([\d.]+)px/.exec(fb), h=mh?+mh[1]:20, w, gx, yL=y, _bot;
edits.replacement: var fb=FSz(TYPE.title,z), fs=FSz(TYPE.micro,z), mh=/([\d.]+)px/.exec(fb), h=mh?+mh[1]:20, w, gx, yL=y+Math.round(10*z), _bot;   // v28.xx (cw-scoretop): the whole block rides 10 pixels lower (the label) and 14 (the number) so the SCORE label is not clipped at the top edge (the critic, 10-19)

edits.anchor: ctx.font=fs; ctx.fillStyle='#ffc04a'; hudText(solo?'SCORE':'TEAM SCORE',cx,Math.round(yL-h*0.80));   // v23.54 (arcade30): SCORE in the 1 player arcade
edits.replacement: ctx.font=fs; ctx.fillStyle=UIC.tx_2; hudText(solo?'SCORE':'TEAM SCORE',cx,Math.round(yL-h*0.80));   // v23.54 (arcade30): SCORE in the 1 player arcade; v28.xx (cw-scoretop): the label is quiet grey (amber is for a warning), the number is the hero
